Traffic advisory
State Route 168 near the Shaver Lake Dam is currently closed to remove a spilled load causing lane blockage. Caltrans is assisting with the closure. use caution in the area and expect slow and stopped traffic for both eastbound and westbound lanes.    @CHP_HQ
